svg.title: Seven responsibilities, one conceptual stack
svg.desc: A seven-drawer network cabinet arranged from the medium upward. The OSI model is a teaching model; real protocols do not always fit cleanly into one drawer.
svg.text: Transmit bits through a medium, such as cable or radio.
Frame data on a local link. Examples include Ethernet, Wi-Fi, and switches.
Route packets between networks. Examples include IP, ICMP, and routers.
Provide stream or datagram transport, illustrated by TCP and UDP.
Model establishment, management, and closure of sessions.
Model data representation, encryption, and compression. TLS, JSON, and JPEG are
illustrative associations, not exact OSI implementations.
Provide application-facing network services such as HTTP, DNS, and SMTP.
